title: ClientConfig is #[non_exhaustive]: preserves minor-version field additions
description: ClientConfig carries #[non_exhaustive] so callers outside the crate must write ..ClientConfig::default() rather than a struct literal. This means adding a new field (e.g. max_sse_frame_body or proxy_url) is a non-breaking minor-version change. A contributor might 'simplify' this by removing the attribute to allow direct struct literal construction in user code, but that would make every new field a semver-breaking change. The attribute is load-bearing for forward compatibility and must be kept.
